_comment_automerge: Patch versions merge themselves on a green build; anything larger is read by a human. Rationale in docs/architecture/12-security.md §12.10.

packageRules.description: Patch updates merge automatically once CI is green.
Minor and major updates are always reviewed by a person.
The stack's stateful services stay on their major line. A PostgreSQL, OpenSearch or RabbitMQ major is a migration, not a dependency bump.
prBodyNotes: A major update of this service is a migration with its own runbook — open it deliberately, not through Renovate.

packageRules.description: Container images are referenced by digest, so digest updates are the real update path.
Java is on an LTS line; moving off it is a decision with an ADR.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
